ModMetaData.name: Auto Hunt Tweaks
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Small UI tweaks for Auto Hunt and Auto Tame:
- Auto Hunt: adds a settings-cog button next to its toggle, so you don't have to dig through the mod list to reach its options. - Optional setting: move Auto Hunt's toggle+cog to the bottom of the Wildlife tab, regardless of whether Numbers is installed. - Numbers compatibility: if Numbers is also loaded, Auto Hunt's toggle+cog and Auto Tame's settings button are redrawn on Numbers' wild animals table (bottom-right and bottom-left respectively) so Numbers' tab buttons no longer cover them.
Auto Hunt, Auto Tame, and Numbers are each optional — this mod only adds the tweaks for whichever of them you have loaded.
